authoritative_evidence.text: Alert: cross-tenant PATCH by tenant-6-alpha targeting tenant-6-bravo/order-6.

judge_input.report_text: Investigation: tenant-6-alpha issued a PATCH to tenant-6-bravo/order-6. The gateway records status 403, state_changed=false, and is_admin=false [log-1].
